# mtncloud_mos_objects (Data Source)

Lists the objects in a MOS bucket, in name order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The top level of a bucket, like a folder listing.
data "mtncloud_mos_objects" "site" {
  bucket    = "acme-website"
  delimiter = "/"
}

output "folders" {
  value = data.mtncloud_mos_objects.site.common_prefixes
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket` (String) The bucket's name.

### Optional

- `delimiter` (String) Group names by this character, usually `/`: objects "in a folder" are left out, and the folders are listed in `common_prefixes`.
- `max_keys` (Number) At most this many objects, 1 to 100000. Defaults to 1000.
- `prefix` (String) Only objects whose names start with this.

### Read-Only

- `common_prefixes` (List of String) The folders under `prefix`, when `delimiter` is set.
- `id` (String) `<bucket>/<prefix>`.
- `objects` (Attributes List) The objects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--objects))

<a id="nestedatt--objects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `objects`

Read-Only:

- `etag` (String) Its ETag.
- `key` (String) The object's name.
- `last_modified` (String) When it was last written (RFC 3339).
- `size` (Number) Its size in bytes.
